### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **4** package(s): `@objectstack/lint`, `@objectstack/platform-objects`, `@objectstack/plugin-sharing`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **5** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **3** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/lint/src/validate-object-field-refs.ts`, `packages/spec/liveness/object.json`, `packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**5** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/concepts/metadata-driven.mdx`  _(via ObjectSchemaBase (symbol, a top-level const object))_
- `content/docs/data-modeling/objects.mdx`  _(via highlightFields (symbol, a field of const object ObjectSchemaBase, an authorable key of data/Object), highlightFields (literal, a string literal in sections))_
- `content/docs/data-modeling/schema-design.mdx`  _(via highlightFields (symbol, a field of const object ObjectSchemaBase, an authorable key of data/Object), highlightFields (literal, a string literal in sections))_
- `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx`  _(via highlightFields (symbol, a field of const object ObjectSchemaBase, an authorable key of data/Object), highlightFields (literal, a string literal in sections))_
- `content/docs/ui/forms.mdx`  _(via highlightFields (symbol, a field of const object ObjectSchemaBase, an authorable key of data/Object), highlightFields (literal, a string literal in sections))_

⛔ **3** release-owned page(s) also name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v12.mdx`  _(via highlightFields (symbol, a field of const object ObjectSchemaBase, an authorable key of data/Object), highlightFields (literal, a string literal in sections))_
- `content/docs/releases/v15.mdx`  _(via highlightFields (symbol, a field of const object ObjectSchemaBase, an authorable key of data/Object), highlightFields (literal, a string literal in sections))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-4.mdx`  _(via highlightFields (symbol, a field of const object ObjectSchemaBase, an authorable key of data/Object), highlightFields (literal, a string literal in sections))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **3** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/lint/src/validate-object-field-refs.ts`, `packages/spec/liveness/object.json`, `packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **5** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **65** of **247** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **182** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **182**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **123** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **174** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json f3c9d426f9dc5c0a791f5f6621951e61b3feba8e` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `b70457c3979ba77d4ec98de4ed5ebcdda36a5add` — the merge of head `e552fec501a7d281f42f89b6557ce9b104a91c7e` into base `f3c9d426f9dc5c0a791f5f6621951e61b3feba8e`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin b70457c3979ba77d4ec98de4ed5ebcdda36a5add && git checkout b70457c3979ba77d4ec98de4ed5ebcdda36a5add
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin f3c9d426f9dc5c0a791f5f6621951e61b3feba8e e552fec501a7d281f42f89b6557ce9b104a91c7e && git checkout -B drift-repro f3c9d426f9dc5c0a791f5f6621951e61b3feba8e && git merge --no-ff e552fec501a7d281f42f89b6557ce9b104a91c7e

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json f3c9d426f9dc5c0a791f5f6621951e61b3feba8e
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs f3c9d426f9dc5c0a791f5f6621951e61b3feba8e` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## 席位核对 — REWORK (L1-c) · repo:objectstack#1 · head `6c5199bbc1` · 2026-11-21T03:44Z

Read at `6c5199bb`: 43 files, +133/−105. The face is `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`. `packages/spec` changes are describe/JSDoc/help text only, with no shape change, and no `docs/adr`, so it is not Tier H. `Skills-docs: follow-up #35942` is right.

### Must-fix

1. **Two comments still say the page draws a strip.** The card's acceptance line is "No description, help text or comment says the record page draws a key-field strip or a stage path".
   - `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/synth/buildDefaultPageSchema.ts:836-837`: "the header strip's stage bar and key fields sit above both, objectstack#35597's 「关键字段下面」". The default page draws neither, so say the body tables follow the record's own fields under the header.
   - `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/recordPhoneHeader.ts:20`: "The highlights a phone's header strip shows after its subtitle" on `PHONE_HIGHLIGHTS_MAX`. The file header now says these highlights have no reader on the default page, and this line should agree.
2. **The `semantic/18.field-group-shadowed-six-highlights` upgrade entry is now false.**
   - Its printed `reason` says "The default record page draws the first six highlights in its header strip and leaves those fields out of the Details body".
   - Its `replacement` says to keep a member "out of the first six `highlightFields`".
   - Its `acceptanceCriteria` reads the Details body of the default page.

   Since #35938 the default page draws no strip, and `field-group-shadowed` counts only the record title. An author on 18.x who upgrades is told to rearrange highlights for a warning that no longer judges them. This is in the card's acceptance ("no description … says the record page draws a key-field strip"), and the entry is printed by `os migrate`, so it reaches authors.

   Either way the seat rules, the entry keeps saying what the 18.x step was:
   - **Reword the three strings here.** For example: the warning now judges only the record title, a group emptied by highlights alone no longer warns, and no action is owed. Keep the printed text free of `#ids`, which the cli `migrate-meta-engine-guidance` test refuses, as #35921 found. If you do this here, the seat decides whether `Metadata-protocol:` stays `none`.
   - **Or** name a follow-up card in the body.

### Should-fix

3. **`@object-ui/types` has no changeset entry.** `ui/packages/types/src/layout.ts` changes the JSDoc of the exported `PageNodeSchema`'s slot menu, and that ships in the package's `.d.ts`. Add `'@object-ui/types': patch` to the changeset. l1-face also flags `@object-ui/fields` (`RecordHoverCard.tsx`) and `@objectstack/plugin-sharing` (`sys-record-share.object.ts`), but those are a non-exported const's comment and an inline comment that the build strips, so no entry is owed for them.

### Nits (no re-read needed)

4. `InterfaceListPage.tsx:97`, `objectViewTabs.ts:34` and `core/src/utils/record-title.ts:379` give "the detail highlight strip" as the reason `highlightFields` drops the title. That is still true of a strip a page places, so they are not false, but "a highlight strip (which a page places)" would read better.
5. `phoneRecordHeader(...).highlightFields` now has no reader on the default page, and only the file header says so. Retiring it fits #35978 or the `BuildPageOptions` retirement.

### Checked and fine

- **Shape.** Draft, base `main`. `Fixes #35943` is right once 1–2 are done. Retiring the three `BuildPageOptions` keys is out of scope, as the claim says.
- **Every new sentence read against the code:**
  - `highlightFields` readers: `RecordHoverCard`, `RelatedList.tsx` default columns, `deriveLookupColumns` (the picker) and the list faces.
  - "the status tag beside the record name shows its stage": `recordStageTag` uses `detectStatusField`, and `stageField: false` returns null, so the Studio "None — … the record header shows no stage" line is true.
  - "a page that places a `record:highlights` block drops them from the body": `HighlightFieldsContext`.
  - `RECORD_HIGHLIGHTS_MAX` now cuts only `buildDefaultHighlights`.
  - The liveness ledger note.
- **The one code change.** `buildDefaultPageSchema` reads no `options.highlightFields`. The only reads, at lines 579–582, are in `buildDefaultHighlights`, so dropping both pass-throughs in `RecordDetailView` changes nothing, and the phone subtitle still takes `synthParts.highlightFields`. The hunk is the synth call, not the header region, and #35910 has merged.
- **Locales.** I read the zh-CN and ja-JP `metadata-forms` help text and the Studio en/zh `stageField` / `stageNone` strings. Each says the same as the en source.
- **Generated files.** `object.mdx`, `metadata.mdx`, `migration.mdx`, `record.mdx` and `sdui.manifest.json` carry the new describe byte for byte. The lint explain pin follows its sentence.
- **Changeset.** I read it sentence by sentence, and it matches the diff, apart from finding 3.
- **Overlap.** As the body says, there are text conflicts with #35921 (`object.zod.ts`, `object.mdx`) and #35923 (generated docs). Whichever lands second regenerates.
- **Gates.** At `6c5199bbc1`: 61 success, 9 expected skip, 0 failed, 0 pending. `mergeable_state` is clean. A delta re-read is owed for 1–3.
